scope: Identical module matrix shapes across ordinary, reversible graph and reversible inverse arms. Dense square attention estimate, not actual fused kernel operations.
caveats: One MAC means multiply-accumulate, not a full FLOP count.
Causal attention implementations can elide masked work; this is a static full-square convention.
Inverse backprop recomputes attention and MLP forward operations, so equal forward MAC count does not mean equal training compute.
There is no second stored feed-forward graph for inverse mode, but recomputation produces temporary local graphs.
